crossRefs.note: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.
Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.
Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

parallels.note: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

translations.web: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
translations.bsb: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
translations.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
translations.asv: And again he began to teach by the sea side. And there is gathered unto him a very great multitude, so that he entered into a boat, and sat in the sea; and all the multitude were by the sea on the land.
